tidbit: Did you know… one story this hour was carried by two different outlets in the last few hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Moonshot AI's Kim K3.1 Pro model features 3T parameters and scores 92.7% on BenchCAD, excelling in 3D modeling and financial analysis. Confirmed by SiliconANGLE.
Grok's Enterprise Vault secures sensitive data with customer-controlled encryption and doesn't use it for training. Reported by BASENOR.
TeraWulf has signed a 20-year lease agreement with Anthropic expected to generate 19 billion dollars in revenue. Reported by Fox Business.
Moonshot AI's Kimi K3.1 Pro scores near frontier on benchmarks, with full weights to be released November 4. Reported by R&D World.
Amazon stores artificial intelligence server racks in warehouses due to power shortages at data centers. Reported by The American Bazaar.
